title: March of the Machine: The Aftermath Promos: card flavor text
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A plane whose angels, after vanquishing their ancient enemy, turned against their former captors, the demons.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: A city on Ikoria that was reduced to ruins and became a playground for the plane's monsters.

entities.name: Orn
entities.description: A place on Ikoria that was previously reduced to a playground for monsters, as Drannith later was.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: A plane known for its monsters, home to Drannith and Orn.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders whose architectural designs had to be removed from rebuilt cities, though their materials were reused.

events.summary: With their ancient enemy vanquished, the angels of New Capenna turn their attention to the demons who once held them captive.
events.quote: With their ancient enemy vanquished, the angels of New Capenna turned their eyes to their former captors: demons.

events.summary: Survivors rebuild a city, removing the Phyrexian design but reusing its materials.
events.quote: The Phyrexian design had to go, but the materials could be put to good use.

events.summary: Drannith is reduced to ruins and becomes a playground for Ikoria's monsters, as Orn was before it.
events.quote: Like Orn before it, Drannith was reduced to a playground for Ikoria's monsters.
